text: Regular exercise offers numerous benefits for both physical and mental health. Studies have consistently shown that people who stay active tend to sleep better and report lower levels of stress. There are several simple ways to build exercise into a busy schedule. First, walking or cycling to work is an easy place to start. Second, short workouts at home can be surprisingly effective, even if it's only twenty minutes. Honestly, the hardest part is just getting started. Finally, finding an activity you actually enjoy makes it far more likely that you'll stick with it over time.
